summary: Both printed pages match the January 2018 (ENCS) PDF structure and computed totals (including negative Schedule I adjustment), but long text in comb-divided boxes (Item 9 address, Item 13A treaty specify, Page 2 header name, Schedule I bank/number) prints as plain text over comb ticks; Page 2 header prints the full name instead of Last Name for an individual; Schedule I Col 1 (Previous Month/s) is unmapped in agent-forms and Schedule I is capped at 3 rows with no overflow path.

test_data.profile: Juana Santos long-name demo profile (TIN 000-123-453-00000, RDO 008, Makati long address)
test_data.schedule_overflow_attempted: Schedule I has 3 printed rows and is hard-capped at MAX_SCHEDULE_1_ROWS=3 in form_1601c.rs with no Add row button on screen.

defects.description: Long registered address prints as continuous plain text directly over the vertical comb tick marks on both lines, with line 1 slightly clipped at the right edge.

defects.area: Part I Item 13A If yes, specify
defects.description: Treaty/special-law text ('PEZA / SPECIAL ECONOMIC ZONE ACT RA 7916') prints as continuous plain text directly over the vertical comb tick marks.

Prints the full taxpayer name ('SANTOS, JUANA MARIA DELA CRUZ-VILLANUEVA') as plain text across comb ticks, whereas the official form asks for 'Last Name for Individual OR Registered Name for Non-Individual' in comb boxes.

defects.area: Part IV Schedule I Col 3 (Drawee Bank/Agency) & Col 4 (Number)
defects.description: Bank codes ('BDO-001', 'BPI-042', 'MBTC-108') and payment reference numbers ('ROR-2025-00123456') print as continuous text colliding with the vertical comb tick marks.

defects.area: Part IV Schedule I Col 1 (Previous Month/s MM/YYYY) & row limit
defects.description: frm1601c:sched1:txtMonthYear0..2 is listed in agent-forms boxes but missing from bindings (unmapped), so Schedule I Col 1 prints blank via form.fill; additionally Schedule I is capped at 3 rows (no UI/API overflow past printed rows).
Specify text sits flush on the printed underline with minimal vertical clearance.

defects.area: Page 2 lower half Guidelines and Instructions
defects.description: Official PDF prints Guidelines and Instructions on the lower half of Page 2; app omits guidelines from the printed sheet (moved to guide.html).
